widgets_values: A wide shot opens on three girls splashing in the ocean under bright sunlight with waves gently crashing around their ankles. First, one girl kicks her legs high and laughs as water sprays over her shoulders, then she grabs a floating beach ball and throws it toward her friends as giggles echo through the air, before all three dive into the water together in a synchronized splash that sends droplets flying everywhere, finally surfacing side by side with arms raised and hair dripping wet, grinning at the camera as they shout. The camera bounces slightly with their splashes, zooming in on the beach ball mid-air before pulling back to capture their joyful group pose. 用标准普通话说：The character says, 快来玩啊 in a cheerful and inviting voice.
你是文生图大模型的prompt撰写大师，把这张图片的prompt用中文给我写出来。

你是LTX-2视频大模型的prompt撰写大师，提示词撰写规则是：

第一、需要确定镜头构图，最好是使用电影术语进行描述你想要的风格。
第二、描述视频氛围，比如视频光线、色彩风格、要表达的感情
第三、描述动作，将主角动作按照时间顺序写出来，尽量的自然流畅
第四，确定运镜，说清楚镜头何时切换。包括镜头移动后主角的状态
第五，描述配音，请使用清晰的文案描述出视频环境音、音乐、音频和主角对话。对于主角对话，请将台词放在引号内，并注明你希望角色使用的语言和口音。

你给我生成出中文提示词。只要最终提示词结果。

blurry, oversaturated, pixelated, low resolution, grainy, distorted, noise, compression artifacts, jpeg artifacts, glitches, watermark, text, logo, signature, copyright, subtitles, distorted sound, saturated sound, loud

10s视频，3D卡通风格。一只猫和一只狗坐在一起，猫快速凑到狗身边说：“人类天天喊，上班累成狗！”
狗晃着尾巴贱笑吐槽：“我班都不用上，人类哪有我过得爽！”
话音落下，猫狗对视一眼，当场笑到打滚。
